---
title: "Tidy the WHO dataset"
author: "Isabella Flego"
output: html_document
---

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
who <- who
```

### step 1: gather
```{r}
who1 <- who |>
  pivot_longer(
   cols = new_sp_m014:newrel_f65,
   names_to = "key",
   values_to = "cases",
   values_drop_na = TRUE)
who1
```

### Step 2: replace
```{r}
who2 <- who1 |>
  mutate(key = stringr::str_replace(key, "newrel", "new_rel"))
who2
```

### Step 3: separate
```{r}
who3 <- who2 |> 
  separate(
    col = key,
    into = c("new", "type", "sexage"),
    sep = "_")
who3
```

```{r}
who4 <- who3 |> 
  separate(
  col = sexage,
  into = c("sex", "age"),
  sep = 1)
who4
```

```{r}
who5 <- who4 |> 
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "014", "0014")) |>
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "65", "65100")) |>
  separate(age, into = c("age_low", "age_high"), sep = 2)
who5
```

### Step 4: drop
```{r}
who5 |>  count(new)

who6 <- who5 |> 
  select(-new, -iso2, -iso3)
who6
```

### Last step
```{r}
whofinal <- who |>
  pivot_longer(cols = new_sp_m014:newrel_f65, names_to = "key", values_to = "cases", values_drop_na = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(key = stringr::str_replace(key, "newrel", "new_rel")) |> 
  separate(col = key, into = c("new", "type", "sexage"), sep = "_") |>
  separate(col = sexage, into = c("sex", "age"), sep = 1) |>
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "014", "0014")) |>
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "65", "65100")) |>
  separate(age, into = c("age_low", "age_high"), sep = 2) |>
  select(-new, -iso2, -iso3)

whofinal  
```
